heading: Art. 40. Continuances
lead: The military judge or a summary court-martial may, for reasonable cause, grant a continuance to any party for such time, and as often, as may appear to be just.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 84050:615.May 5, 1950, ch. 169, § 1 (Art. 40), 64 Stat. 121.
